body: GENDER shipped through gates. Gold: 0/533 shared gold columns change prediction vs 0.6.29 head — headline 0.719 holds (no gold gender_code rows; gold gender col is words male/female/no_answer, unaffected). Corpus-honest gate (33,007-col stratified sample, gate_gender-code.json): GO, zero triggers. gender_code oracle-confirmed-correct 985->2629 (2.67x), marginal ratio 1.17 (<3x band), net contra-in 111. gender marginal -85% (12916->1957) but oracle-confirmed support holds 1035->1035 (zero confirmed gender lost) — clean relocation of M/F mislabels, NOT error relocation. First clean GO on a massive-relocation precision fix; validates composition-aware over_emit band. ac-01+ac-02 closed.

ac-03 npi: MOOT — fixture already valid. All 60 medical_records.csv npi values begin 1 or 2 and pass ^[12]\d{9}$ at 100%; profiles to identity.medical.npi with no veto. The audit's '41 of 60 begin 3-9' snapshot was stale (fixture regenerated since). Validator untouched, as required. ac-04 price: REMAINS, and is bigger than a reroute. Without the hint the model reads '9140,88 €' as integer_number (doesn't recognise euro-comma at all), so dropping the hint is not the fix. The value shape (4-digit int, comma decimal, space, € suffix, NO thousands dot) does NOT cleanly match amount_comma_suffix's strict ^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{3})*(,[0-9]{1,2})?\s?[sym]$ either. Needs a design pass: which amount_* variant, fixture representativeness, value-aware hint resolution vs a value rule, and its own gold+corpus gates. Recommend carving price into its own spec under card 0002.
